title: catalogue: subject benchmarks collection
description: catalogue/context/subject/benchmarks.json indexes the subject benchmarks, parallel to catalogue/pathways.json. Each entry points at one subject's benchmark file under catalogue/context/subject/benchmarks/<id>.json. The benchmarks are the CXP-phase reference: a subject context resolves (by HECoS/CAH code or name) to its benchmark, which tells the authoring agent how this subject's standards bear on each pathway.

id.description: Matches subjectBenchmarkId in the entry file.

codes.description: Headline HECoS/CAH codes for quick subject resolution; the full set is in the entry file.
